about.label: About Us
about.heading: The Detailing Monk
paragraphs: Where devotion meets detailing. At our studio, there is a fusion of American innovation and European perfection with Indian heritage — a harmony of technology, precision, and tradition.

We blend precision, care, and craft to protect and beautify your car. From premium washes to ceramic coatings and PPF, every service reflects our ethos of “Seva Through Detailing.” Your car is more than transport — it is a companion in your journey. That's why we treat every surface with reverence, restoring shine and safeguarding beauty with products from trusted global brands.

services.heading: Our Services
services.intro: At The Detailing Monk, every service is a crafted ritual blending precision, care, and devotion to transform your car.

cards.title: Exterior Care
cards.text: Gentle yet thorough cleaning using premium shampoos, vacuuming, and tire care to remove dirt without harming paint.

cards.title: Interior Care
cards.text: Drycleaning, steam treatment, and odor removal to refresh cabins and restore hygiene.

cards.title: Detailing Touch
cards.text: Multistage compounding and polishing to eliminate swirl marks and scratches, revealing a deep mirror finish.

cards.title: Paint Care
cards.text: Ceramic, graphene, and PPF applications that bond with the paint, creating long term shields against UV rays, oxidation, and contaminants.

cta.text: Not sure what your car needs? Send us a photo and we'll suggest the right package.
